seo.description: Aikido classes for adults in Benfica, Encarnação and Lumiar, from lunchtime to evening.

title: A practice for life.
lead: Non-competitive and open to beginners and experienced practitioners.
paragraphs: Aikido prioritises balance, coordination and relationship over strength and speed.
Through repetition, we learn to receive force without opposing it directly, developing calm, concentration and confidence.
